question: To what kind of person, endowed with all states and of resolved mind, is this teaching to be given?
premises: Not every person is fit to receive this teaching.
Fitness requires being endowed with all states.
Fitness also requires being one of resolved mind.
inference: This teaching is to be given to one who is endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: The meaning of 'endowed with all states' is not defined in this verse.
plain_english: It is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
